android.desc:
Connect Words is an immersive puzzle game designed to enhance cognitive abilities by encouraging players to broaden their vocabulary and refine word skills through letter connections. The gameplay, while straightforward, offers entertainment by presenting players with a letter grid and the objective of constructing words.

As players progress, they encounter progressively intricate puzzles that demand critical thinking and creative problem-solving. Whether you're in the mood for a mental challenge, an enjoyable word-matching experience complete with hints, or an endless array of puzzles, this free app is certainly worth exploring!

FEATURES:

✔ 10,000+ Levels: Immerse yourself in a vast collection of over 10,000 levels, each carefully crafted to enhance your word skills and cognitive thinking.

✔  FREE Updates: Enjoy a continuous stream of fresh content with regular updates, keeping the challenges exciting and ensuring you always have new puzzles to conquer.

✔ Daily Free Spin: Start your day with a spin! Earn valuable rewards daily, adding an element of surprise and delight to your word-connecting adventure.

✔ Offline Play: Take the challenge anywhere, anytime. Connect Words supports an offline version, allowing you to hone your word skills even when you're not connected.

✔ Progressive Difficulty: As you ascend through the levels, face increasingly intricate puzzles that demand critical thinking and creative problem-solving. The journey is both challenging and rewarding.

✔  Auto-Save Feature: Don't worry about losing your progress. Connect Words automatically saves your game upon closing, allowing you to pick up right where you left off.


 HOW TO PLAY:
1. Select a letter with your finger, then slide it to drag the letters to connect them into a  meaningful word. 

2. If the word matches the number of letter boxes or blocks available, it will fill the empty tiles or blocks to spell the word in the puzzle.

3. If it isn't the word that's meant to be in the puzzle, the block tiles will remain blank.

The game gets more tricky and challenging as you advance to each new higher level, but the good news is it'll help train your brain and build your vocabulary and problem solving skills which will improve the more you play the game!
